scripts.composer-root: d=.; i=0; while [ $i -lt 10 ]; do if [ -f "$d/composer.json" ] && cat "$d/composer.json" | grep -q '"type"' && cat "$d/composer.json" | grep -q '"project"'; then readlink -f "$d"; break; fi; d="../$d"; i=$((i+1)); done
scripts.install-dev-deps: PACKAGES=$(cat composer.json | jq -r '.["require-dev"] // {} | to_entries[] | "\(.key):\(.value)"' | tr '\n' ' ') && ROOT=$(composer run composer-root) && REPOS=$(cat composer.json | jq -c '.repositories // []') && for REPO in $(echo $REPOS | jq -c '.[]'); do composer --working-dir=${ROOT} config repositories.$(echo $REPO | jq -r '.package.name // empty' | tr '/' '-') "$REPO" 2>/dev/null || true; done && CORE_VERSION=$(grep "const VERSION" "${ROOT}/core/lib/Drupal.php" 2>/dev/null | sed "s/.*'\(.*\)'.*/\1/" || echo "0.0.0") && COMPOSER_ROOT_VERSION=${CORE_VERSION:-0.0.0} composer --working-dir=${ROOT} require ${PACKAGES} --dev -W
scripts.phpcs: mkdir -p test-results && mkdir -p .cache/phpcs && composer --working-dir=$(composer run composer-root) exec phpcs -- --standard=$(pwd)/phpcs.xml --report-width=auto --colors -s --report-junit=$(pwd)/test-results/phpcs.xml --report-full --report-summary $(pwd)
scripts.phpcbf: mkdir -p .cache/phpc && composer --working-dir=$(composer run composer-root) exec phpcbf -- --standard=$(pwd)/phpcs.xml --colors $(pwd)
scripts.phpstan: composer --working-dir=$(composer run composer-root) exec phpstan -- --configuration=$(pwd)/phpstan.neon --autoload-file=$(pwd)/phpstan_rules/autoload.php analyze $(pwd)
scripts.phpstan-regenerate-ignores-for-11.3-and-: rm $(pwd)/phpstan-11.3-and-higher-ignores.neon && touch $(pwd)/phpstan-11.3-and-higher-ignores.neon && composer --working-dir=$(composer run composer-root) exec phpstan -- --configuration=$(pwd)/phpstan.neon --autoload-file=$(pwd)/phpstan_rules/autoload.php --generate-baseline=$(pwd)/phpstan-11.3-and-higher-ignores.neon analyze $(pwd)
scripts.lint:chase-upstream:rector-core: ROOT=$(composer run composer-root) && export RECTOR_MIN_CORE=$(php $(pwd)/scripts/resolve-min-core.php $(pwd) ${ROOT}/vendor/autoload.php) && composer --working-dir=${ROOT} exec rector -- process --config $(pwd)/rector.php --dry-run $(pwd)
scripts.chase-upstream:rector-core: ROOT=$(composer run composer-root) && export RECTOR_MIN_CORE=$(php $(pwd)/scripts/resolve-min-core.php $(pwd) ${ROOT}/vendor/autoload.php) && composer --working-dir=${ROOT} exec rector -- process --config $(pwd)/rector.php $(pwd)

scripts-descriptions.install-dev-deps: Installs Canvas' dev dependencies into host Drupal project.
scripts-descriptions.lint:phpcs: Runs PHPCS using Canvas' rules, generates CI artifact.
scripts-descriptions.lint:chase-upstream:rector-core: Reports (dry-run) upstream Drupal core changes Rector can chase, keeping BC down to Canvas' minimum supported core.
scripts-descriptions.lint:chase-upstream: Reports upstream Drupal core changes Rector can chase, without modifying files.
scripts-descriptions.chase-upstream:rector-core: Applies Rector rules that chase upstream Drupal core changes, keeping BC down to Canvas' minimum supported core.
scripts-descriptions.chase-upstream: Applies Rector rules that chase upstream Drupal core changes, then runs phpcbf.
scripts-descriptions.lint:phpstan: Runs PHPStan using Canvas' rules, generates CI artifact.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan-regenerate-ignores-for-11.3-and-: Regenerates PHPStan baseline for Drupal 11.3 and higher.
scripts-descriptions.phpunit: Runs Canvas' back-end test suite. Supports running subset, use `composer run phpunit -- --help`.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Runs all Canvas back-end (PHP) linting. Sibling: `npm run lint`.
scripts-descriptions.fix: Runs all Canvas back-end (PHP) auto-fixing. Sibling: `npm run fix`.
